question: In relation to the physiology of the complement system, one of the following statements is false:

options.opa: Most of its components are inactive.
options.opb: Its mode of activation is similar to the coagulation cascade.
options.opc: It is subject to strict control of regulatory mechanisms.
options.opd: It is only activated by two different routes: the classical and the alternative.
options.ope: During its activation, multimolecular complexes are formed.
